meta.jurisdiction: India DPDP Act 2023 + institutional clinical governance (demo assumption)
meta.purpose: Triage assist only — not diagnosis, treatment, or EHR write
meta.esi_framework: ESI 1–5 reference bands; DoorBoard ranks within ties and against open space
design_notes: Half the room shares ESI 3 — DoorBoard's core story (ties ESI cannot break)
Matched fever 38.5°C: pediatric P08 (3y) vs adult P07 (36y) vs geriatric P09 (75y)
Geriatric fever 38.0°C (P09) — elderly often under-mount fever
Under-reporter P20 — words mild, look/vitals bad
Quiet watcher P02 — looks well at baseline; demo worsens vitals
Missing SpO2 P05 — refuse can-wait
Zero vitals P15 — low confidence + escalate
Wait exceeded at baseline: P16 (ESI3>30m), P13 (ESI4 near ceiling)
Transfer P14 — partial outside notes, imperfect intake
Consent withheld P17 — DPDP demo (still first-minute facts only)
Language barrier P10 — incomplete HPI, lower confidence, escalate
Bounceback <72h P05 — same complaint return, do not park as new mild
Isolation P07 — fever+cough, cohort space not normal bay
Pregnancy P14 — abdominal pain transfer, pathway caution
Intoxication P03 — unreliable historian after fall
Stroke pathway P11 — clock running since EMS alert
STEMI pathway P01 — critical + door-to-ECG clock
LWBS risk on long-wait mild ESI 4–5
Boarders reduce usable bays; staffing shock button drops nurses
Expanded to 30 patients (above 15–20 minimum) for richer surge and tie-breaking demos
Extra ped/geri, ambiguous, sepsis pathway, anaphylaxis-risk, LWBS ESI5
meta.notes: Synthetic patients only. Not a medical record.
meta.reference_labels: reference_priority is a team consensus target tier over synthetic patients, used so the under-triage claim can be measured. Not clinical ground truth, not signed off by a clinician.
meta.age_bands: infant <1, toddler 1-2, preschool 3-5, school 6-12, adolescent 13-17, adult 18-64, geriatric 65+ (APLS/PALS strata)
meta.vital_scales: NEWS2 (RCP 2017) for 18+, PEWS/APLS bands for under 18
